# CountyLayer

> CountyLayer is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing Tulsa County, Oklahoma property and parcel data for AI agents to query programmatically.

## Tools

- **search_properties(address)**: Look up property records by street address, partial-match.
- **lookup_owner(owner_name)**: Look up all properties owned by a given name, partial-match.
- **get_property_details(account_no)**: Get the full record for a single property by its account number.

## Data

Tulsa County, Oklahoma parcel records, approximately 250,000 parcels, sourced from INCOG's public ArcGIS feed. Fields include owner name and address, property address, legal description, sale history, physical characteristics, and assessed value.

## Docs

- [Pricing](https://countylayer.com/index.html#pricing): Manual ($29/month, 1,000 queries/month, 20 requests/minute) and Agent ($99/month, 10,000 queries/month, 200 requests/minute) tiers. Annual billing and the current founding-member discount are also shown there.
- [Connect](https://countylayer.com/index.html#how-it-works): MCP client configuration (endpoint URL and API key header) for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.
